title: Someone built the world's biggest AI prompt library, made it free
description:
Someone just built the world's biggest AI prompt library, made it completely free, and you can plug the entire thing straight into your Claude Code.

It's called prompts.chat: over 10,000 tested prompts for writing, coding, images, video and research, all open source. The real unlock is plugging it into Claude Code as an MCP server, so your agent automatically grabs the best prompt for whatever you're working on. You never copy-paste anything again.

Comment PROMPT and I'll send you the link.

#promptlibrary #aiprompting #claudecode #mcp #opensourceai
